props.heading: Privacy policy
props.body:
Sample copy for demonstration. This is not legal advice and must be reviewed before production use.

Information we collect

This website may collect information you submit through enquiry forms, including your name, email, phone, company, and message, plus technical information needed to secure the service.

How we use it

We use enquiry data to respond, manage recruitment, and improve the website experience. We do not sell personal data.

Retention

Enquiry data is retained for no more than 24 months after the last contact unless a legal or contractual obligation requires otherwise.

Your rights

You may request access, correction, or deletion by writing to hello@meridian.example.
